<!--
Harmonization-flow diagram, laid out with flexbox + CSS grid (no absolute
positioning), so spacing and centering adjust automatically to font-size changes.
Included on a slide with:  {{< include _harmonization-flow-diagram.qmd >}}
Must stay inside a ```{=html} fence so Pandoc passes it through verbatim.

Layout:
- Outer wrapper is a flex row; align-items:center vertically centers the
  multiplication sign and the domain list against the dashed container.
- The dashed container is a 5-column grid: label | arrow | label | arrow | label.
  Row 1 = stage labels + block arrows; row 2 = the box stack (col 1) and the
  reformat steps (col 3), so each content column sits under its label.
Tweak gaps/padding to adjust spacing; there are no pixel coordinates to recompute.
-->
```{=html}
<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; color: #4F4A4A; font-size: 34px; margin-top: 20px;">

  <!-- Box container: 5-column grid (label / arrow / label / arrow / label) -->
  <!-- Frame wrapper: grid content shows from the start; the box outline is a
       separate overlay that appears as a fragment (grid itself has no border). -->
  <div style="position: relative; display: inline-block;">

  <!-- Box outline overlay: appears with the multiplication sign and heading -->
  <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4" style="position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 2px solid #4F4A4A; border-radius: 24px; pointer-events: none;"></div>

  <div style="display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: auto 50px auto 50px auto; column-gap: 8px; row-gap: 28px; align-items: center; justify-items: center; padding: 24px;">

    <!-- Row 1: stage labels + block arrows -->
    <div style="grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; padding: 10px; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 8px;">Clinical data</div>
    <div style="grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; width: 50px; height: 26px; background: #4F4A4A; clip-path: polygon(0 30%, 60% 30%, 60% 0, 100% 50%, 60% 100%, 60% 70%, 0 70%);"></div>
    <div style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; padding: 10px; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 8px;">Reformat</div>
    <div style="grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1; width: 50px; height: 26px; background: #4F4A4A; clip-path: polygon(0 30%, 60% 30%, 60% 0, 100% 50%, 60% 100%, 60% 70%, 0 70%);"></div>
    <div style="grid-column: 5; grid-row: 1; padding: 10px; white-space: nowrap; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 8px;">Harmonized output</div>

    <!-- Row 2, col 1: stack of empty dataset boxes -->
    <div style="grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; align-self: start; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
      <div style="font-size: 28px; text-align: center; color: #ADA599;">15 trials</div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 3px;"></div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 3px;"></div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 3px;"></div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 3px;"></div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; text-align: center; color: #ADA599;">...</div>
      <div style="width: 150px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 3px;"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Row 2, col 3: reformat steps under "Reformat" -->
    <div style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; align-self: start; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; color: #ADA599;" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
      <div>Pivot wide</div>
      <div>Primary keys</div>
      <div>Match columns</div>
      <div>Data type</div>
      <div>Factor values</div>
      <div>Missing codes</div>
      <div>Unit of measure</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Row 2, col 5: empty harmonized-output box under "Harmonized output" -->
    <div style="grid-column: 5; grid-row: 2; align-self: start; width: 150px; height: 250px; border: 1px solid #ADA599; border-radius: 5px; margin-top: 34px;" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3"></div>

  </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Multiplication sign: flex item between the box and the domain list -->
  <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4" style="font-size: 80px; font-weight: bold;">&#10799;</div>

  <!-- Domain list (caption + items), vertically centered by the wrapper -->
  <div style="font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.5; color: #ADA599;">
    <div style="font-size: 34px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #4F4A4A;" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4">10 datasets</div>
    <div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="5">
      <div>&#9888;&#65039; Adverse events</div>
      <div>&#128101; Demographics</div>
      <div>&#127973; Hospitalization</div>
      <div>&#129514; Lab tests</div>
      <div>&#128138; Medications</div>
      <div>&#128200; Response</div>
      <div>&#9201;&#65039; Time to event</div>
      <div>&#128137; Treatment</div>
      <div>&#129658; Visits</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- Decorative emoji, bottom-left corner (~100px tall). On the final build step
     it swaps to a screaming face: the first fades out and the second fades in at
     the same position (shared data-fragment-index = the last step). -->
<div class="fragment fade-out" data-fragment-index="6" style="position: absolute; left: 330px; bottom: 30px; font-size: 150px; line-height: 1;">👩🏻‍💻</div>
<div class="fragment fade-in"  data-fragment-index="6" style="position: absolute; left: 330px; bottom: 30px; font-size: 150px; line-height: 1;">😱</div>
```
